summary: After Sundown is a 2006 American horror-Western film directed by Christopher Abram and Michael W. Brown and written by Abram. The film stars Susana Gibb, Reece Rios, Natalie Jones, and the co-directors Brown and Abram. Its premise is that a vampire gunslinger from the Old West terrorizes a modern-day town after his bride is revived.
one_line: A 2006 American horror-Western film about a vampire gunslinger who terrorizes a modern town after his bride is revived.
